description: This file defines APIs related to LAN management within the COSA Data Model Library, including function declarations for getting and setting parameters, validation, commit and rollback operations. It is part of a larger firmware or SDK for device management.

methods.name: LanManagement_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for LAN management.

methods.name: LanManagement_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for LAN management.

methods.name: LanManagement_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for LAN management.

methods.name: LanManagement_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for LAN management.

methods.name: LanManagement_Validate
methods.description: Validates the current LAN management configuration.

methods.name: LanManagement_Commit
methods.description: Commits the LAN management configuration changes.

methods.name: LanManagement_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the LAN management configuration changes.
